title: Actuate Therapeutics Obtains Complete Responses and Provides Update on Clinical Trial of Elraglusib for the Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Ewing Sarcoma
description: Actuate Therapeutics' elraglusib demonstrated anti-tumor activity with two ongoing complete responses and a 62% disease control rate in a Phase 1/2 trial for relapsed/refractory Ewing sarcoma. Enrollment is ongoing, with topline data anticipated in the first half of 2025.

title: Actuate to Participate in Lantern’s Pharma Webinar on AI-Driven Drug Development
description: Actuate Therapeutics and Lantern Pharma are collaborating to accelerate the development of Actuate's lead drug candidate, elraglusib, and enable the screening for additional biomarkers to assess and predict its therapeutic activity and clinical outcomes.
